card.name: Words before names of leagues and committees
card.fires_on: Small words like its, the, a, other and national right before the name of an association, league, committee or society. Seen in historical and political prose about organizations.

modes.label: Possessive before group work
modes.description: A word like its that refers to an association and comes before what it does or who runs it.
modes.example: he must communicate with<< its>> able managers, and they would soon use

modes.label: The before a named committee
modes.description: The word the right before the name of a committee, club or session of a society.
modes.example: In 1921 the League of Nations established<< the>> Committee on the Traffic in Women and Children

modes.label: Modifier before association
modes.description: A describing word placed before the word association or society.
modes.example: the first<< national>> association dedicated to organizing women workers

card.writes: It seems to push words about organizing and organizations, though the promoted tokens look mixed and weak.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the name of a league, committee or society in historical text.
